original_problem: Warm color command physically does not change lamp although RMT receive stores it and Arduino RMT transmit returns DRIVER_OK. Two independent TX HTTP calls both report duration 4065ms for a recorded ~64881us waveform.

analysis.diagnosis: USB HWCDC backpressure can stall Serial writes for roughly 2 seconds per buffered write; 4-second and 6-second execution-time figures closely track this known failure, but timing must be confirmed on the user's Mac.
analysis.observed_RMT_HAL_behavior: rmtWrite waits for TX_DONE, called with 200ms timeout; successful 4.065s measurement contains additional delays not intrinsically explained by physical waveform duration.
analysis.unproven: A slow API does not itself prove the emitted IR optical waveform is wrong. Lamp may need NEC repeat frames; LED amplitude, wiring and carrier remain unknown.

source_actions: Bound ESP32C3 USB CDC TX timeout to 1ms instead of library default 100ms
Expose TX serial pre/post, RMT write and carrier configuration durations separately
Expose intended waveform length in microseconds
Preserve existing RMT capture, optical carrier, GPIO allocation, alarm and LittleFS logic

release.note: ZIP bundled in single .command, no second download required

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Drive release is byte identical to validated local assembly
User MAC installs new binary and confirms flash readback
tx_pre_serial_ms shows reduced USB output delay and tx_rmt_write_ms plausible versus ~65ms intended waveform
Warm lamp color physically changes on retransmit
Physical IR waveform optically matches original capture or repeat-frame sequence
